questions.subject: ART_HISTORY
questions.topic: What a water-filled moat requires
questions.learningObjective: Synthesise moat requirements

stimulus.body: A legal clerk's file note on a water-filled moat notes it needs a steady water source and controlled outflow. Without both, it dries or floods.

questions.stem: What does the moat require in the note?
questions.explanation: The moat requires a water source and drainage control. Rain alone is insufficient.

questions.subject: ART_HISTORY
questions.topic: The second work a moat denies
questions.learningObjective: Apply moat denial knowledge
questions.stem: A legal clerk's file note asks what a moat denies besides mining; what is best?
questions.explanation: Besides mining, a moat denies direct assault with ladders. It is a physical barrier.
